summary: France's national statistics institute INSEE detected on June 19, 2026 a cyberattack on its staff directory (annuaire des agents) that exposed identity data and professional contact details of about 12,800 current and former staff. INSEE said no passwords, bank, social security, health or personal contact data were involved, and that survey data collected from businesses and households was not compromised. It notified the CNIL, filed a complaint and worked with ANSSI.
